app.api.user_routes.create_user_endpoint(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_session))[source]¶

Create a new user and initialize a main bank account.

This endpoint registers a new user, hashes the password, creates a default main account with an initial balance, and returns a JWT access token.

Parameters:

  • user (UserCreate) – User registration data (name, email, password).

  • db (Session) – Database session dependency.

Raises:

HTTPException –

  • 400 if the email already exists.

Returns:

Access token, token type, and user information.

Return type:

dict
